_comment: Option D — optional headroom token compression. DEFAULT OFF. The hook script no-ops (passthrough) unless REPPIT_HEADROOM=1 is set in the environment AND a local headroom install is importable. It compresses large read-heavy tool outputs before they enter the model context. Healthcare note: enabling this puts tool outputs (possible PHI) through the compressor — review the PHI-data-path caveat in the README before enabling. See plans/autonomous-loops/00-parent-design-doc.md (slice 6).
